# MuVAP vendored source

This directory contains the exact MuVAP source used by the released Multi-TPC notebooks.

- Upstream project: Haotian-Qi/MuVAP
- Commit: `a1ef9c8bde873196da2c37be5e74933c497b6a14`
- Archive SHA-256: `8daecdbd5a079e2f271f8c1d1a68b63895de95a7972c08b69088dbf2213b0126`
- License: MIT (see `MuVAP-main/LICENSE`)

The source was extracted unchanged from the pinned archive used by the executed research notebooks. It is vendored here so the public notebooks do not embed a large base64 dependency inside code cells.
